frames.seen: Four Black men stand smiling in a hall under a Welcome Home banner while holding glowing hourglasses, with three men in white behind them.
The camera pulls back slightly as the four men continue talking and holding their hourglasses in the warmly lit hall.
The camera pulls back further inside the spacious hall while the four men stand together holding their glowing hourglasses.
The camera continues to pull back, revealing more of the wooden ceiling and floor around the small gathering of men.
The wider view shows the four men still standing closely together in the center of the large hall.
The camera pulls back further down the hall, making the group of men appear smaller in the distance.
The wide shot shows the high wooden rafters and tiled walls of the hall as the camera continues retreating from the men.
The group of men stands far in the background of the expansive, mostly empty hall.
From the far end of the hall, the four men including one in a football jersey stand beneath the distant Welcome Home banner.

overall: No, the world does not transform with the words at all; the entire sequence is simply a single continuous camera pullback in the exact same hall. The biggest weakness is the complete lack of visual progression or scene changes to match the rich imagery of forests, canyons, and afterlives in the poem.
